title: Former SpaceX engineers are building a robotic factory for making steel parts
summary: Such robotic efficiency can reduce welding costs by 85 percent, according to Path Robotics. Welding a skid can take two to four hours, but assembling all the cut components for the welding process can take four to five days, Summers explained.
